axial_capture.interpretation: Each planar end section is wider than washer aperture; positive partial bearing persists for stated offset. This does not prove tilt escape, washer flex/strength or arbitrary pose; two cheeks, axle and assembled washers required.

internal_stack.warning: POM length tolerance is not a tolerance for PETG rotor/cavity. If bush shorter it may float between washers; no press-fit or adhesive required.

scope: Hex key prevents bush rotation relative to lever after small clearance backlash; no shaft-to-housing antirotation implied.
Axle may rotate in fixed PETG support bores; they remain potential sliding interfaces.
Existing two thrust washers trap bush only when assembled between cheeks; removing cover releases the stack for bench service.
No final bearing material/grade, lubrication, friction, wear, side-M3 load, nut torque or supplier purchase accepted.
